data.description:
A slim, dual-layer phone case that brings calm confidence to everyday carry. The design keeps the back clean and minimalist with a small, tasteful red broadcast tower accent—subtle enough to blend into work or travel, but distinctive when you notice it. The sturdy polycarbonate shell and TPU silicone liner work together to cushion shocks and guard against drops, while the 3D wrap ensures the artwork stays vibrant. Finished in your choice of glossy or matte, the case supports wireless charging and keeps ports accessible. It’s made to travel with you: weather-resistant, certified for safety, and built for long-term use.

Product features
- Dual-layer construction: 100% polycarbonate shell with 100% TPU silicone liner for impact absorption
- 3D wrap printing with full ink density and image transfer for vivid, long-lasting artwork
- UV protected coating for outdoor resistance and long-term optical quality
- Supports wireless charging; clear open ports for easy connectivity
- Available in glossy or matte finishes; compatible with new iPhone 17 series models

Care instructions
- Clean with a soft damp cotton or microfiber cloth (add a drop of dish soap if needed).

data.description:
This phone case-cardholder combo will keep essential items safe in one place. Trust the polycarbonate to keep it impact-resistant through regular wear and tear. Create your flashy designs, print them all over the exterior, and choose between a glossy or matte finish. If your customers buy it as a present, gift packaging is available. Compatible with iPhone and Samsung Galaxy models.


.: Material: 100% impact-resistant polycarbonate
.: Slim form and lightweight design
.: Magsafe compatible
.: Clear, open ports for connectivity
.: One card storage
.: Available with a glossy or matte finish
.: Gift packaging available
